# Fable 5 — low

> A 1,374-line vanilla-JS Pokédex with a genuinely strong prebuild and a striking Pokédex-as-terminal identity, sitting on a shallow feature spread. build-data.mjs pools 25-way with 5-attempt backoff over every /pokemon, /pokemon-species, /evolution-chain, /type, /ability and /generation resource, resolves generation from the /generation endpoint rather than id ranges, and emits four wire-compacted JSON files; the runtime confirms it works — all 1025 species reachable by scrolling, zero console errors, no exceptions. The single app.js is deliberately ordered (constants → pure helpers → domain functions → one view per route → router → listeners) and the hardest piece of logic in the brief, dual-type defensive effectiveness, is exactly right: I ran defensiveEffectiveness verbatim against live relations and Magnezone→ground 4x, Skarmory→poison/ground 0x, Spiritomb's three immunities all come out canonical. Against that: seven of the thirty features are absent (team builder, damage calc, moves dex, minigame, command palette, export, and filter-state URLs are effectively missing), and the two adjudicated downgrades are real defects rather than depth complaints — the Move Pool panel reads version_group_details[last] (app.js:412) and therefore renders learnsets that match no shipped game (Pikachu: 7 level-up rows vs 20 in SV, levels mixed from blue-japan/LGPE/BDSP/SV, 60 moves dumped into a bogus 'Train' tab), and the keyboard layer ships three bindings with no modifier guard so Ctrl+R and Alt+Left both misfire. The architecture stops one step short of its own ambition: four monolithic files all fetched before first paint (including 196 KB of evolution data the browse view never reads), zero cache headers in wrangler.jsonc, sprites hotlinked off an unpinned raw.githubusercontent.com branch at max-age=300, full-res 130-145 KB artwork used as grid thumbnails, and one core detail surface still calling pokeapi.co live per view with no memoization — even though build-data.mjs:59 already held the move data it needs.

## Strengths

- Dual-type defensive matchups are fully correct — app.js:51-64 multiplies across both types so 4x/¼x emerge and immunities annihilate weaknesses; verified against live relations for Gengar, Skarmory, Magnezone, Dragonite and Spiritomb.
- Build pipeline is the best part of the submission: 25-way concurrency pool with 5-attempt exponential backoff that rethrows instead of silently dropping (build-data.mjs:7-31), limit=100000 list fetches, generation resolved from /generation so forms get the right gen, deterministic sort, and wire-compacted output (positional stat/EV arrays, {n,h} abilities, precomputed has_art/has_anim/cry booleans).
- Real branching evolution trees — build-data.mjs:83 recurses evolves_to and app.js:217-222 walks it breadth-first, so Eevee's 8 branches, both Wurmple lines and all three Tyrogue branches render with conditions paired 1:1 to nodes.
- Visual craft is excellent for 462 hand-written CSS lines: a CSS-only Pokéball boot spinner, mix-blend-mode scanlines, staggered LED blinkers, an inline SVG data-URI favicon, a three-font system, type-derived --accent tokens, 7 keyframes plus a correct double-rAF stat-bar animation (app.js:383-385), and prefers-reduced-motion honoured.
- Well guarded on every route it owns: missing-id, missing-chain and missing-species fallbacks, unknown type slugs still render the matrix, MOVES[name]||{}, a try/catch around the move panel and around boot(), an onerror sprite fallback on all six img sites, and junk hashes falling through to the dex.

## Weaknesses

- Move learnsets are misattributed for every Pokémon: app.js:412 treats version_group_details[last] as the newest game, but that tail is now blue-japan/champions — Pikachu's level-up tab shows 7 rows against SV's 20 with levels mixed across four games, and Bulbasaur (unaffected by the 'train' bucket) mixes Gen-1 blue-japan levels with SV levels into a list matching no shipped title.
- Keyboard layer breaks browser-reserved chords: no ctrlKey/metaKey/altKey guard at app.js:616-629, so Ctrl+R/Cmd+R navigates to a random Pokémon before reloading and Alt+ArrowLeft cancels Back; '/' only works on 1 of 5 routes because app.js:618 optional-chains #search with no fallback.
- Accessibility is the weak half of the UX: exactly one aria-label in 648 lines (app.js:126, static 'favorite'), zero <label> elements, placeholder-only search, 18 type chips conveying state by colour alone with no aria-pressed, no aria-live on the result count, a keyboard-unreachable compare picker, no :focus-visible anywhere plus two outline:none rules, and --ink-faint #5d5b53 at 2.87:1 on bg colouring nearly all secondary microcopy at sub-11px sizes.
- No caching story at all: no _headers, no headers block in wrangler.jsonc, no content-hashed filenames, no Service Worker; all four data files revalidate every load, and imgUrl (app.js:26) feeds full-res 130-145 KB official artwork into grid cards served from an unpinned raw.githubusercontent.com branch at max-age=300.
- Data strategy is monolithic and one surface is still live: all four files (~1.24 MB raw, including 196 KB evolution.json and 38 KB abilities.json the browse view never reads) are fetched before first paint (app.js:633-637), and every detail view re-fetches ~290 KB from pokeapi.co with no memoization or persistence.
- codeQuality scores near zero on the axis's own named criteria: one type="module" file with zero import/export, 11 module-level mutable bindings, no JSDoc/@type anywhere across 1,374 LOC, `list.length = 0; list.push(...fresh)` mutating a closed-over array by reference (app.js:199), byte-identical getJSON duplicated between the two build scripts, DEX.filter(x => x.default) + findIndex duplicated at app.js:251-253 and 622-626, and no package.json/lockfile/tests/lint.
- Confirmed dead code and false affordances: .badge.ghost (style.css:209) never matches since badge() only emits badge/badge lg, .eff .mult (style.css:339) references a local variable, .moves-table th cursor:pointer + user-select + :hover (style.css:377-382) advertises a column sort nothing wires, onclick="void 0" (app.js:495) is superseded two lines later, and build-data.mjs:148 re-implements englishName() in an unreachable fallback.
- Two unguarded boot-window paths: app.js:605-608 binds the RANDOM handler at module load while DEX is still [], so a click (or 'R') during the ~1.2 MB boot fetch does DEX[0].id and throws; and the localStorage favourites JSON.parse at app.js:18 runs at module top level outside boot()'s try/catch, so a corrupt value strands the page on the boot spinner.
- Browse loop loses its place: route() app.js:597 does an unconditional window.scrollTo(0,0) with no history.scrollRestoration and dexView() resets renderCount=0, so Back from a detail page destroys both scroll position and pagination — after browsing to #900 the entire lazy-load must be redone.
- Lossy derived fields: evolution_details sliced to [0] (build-data.mjs:84) so Leafeon/Glaceon show location instead of stone and Tyrogue's three branches read an identical 'Lv 20'; pickFlavor keeps one untagged English entry (build-data.mjs:35-38); compare bars hardcode max=200 (app.js:561) so 255 HP ties with 200.

## Standout

The build pipeline plus the type engine: build-data.mjs pools 25-way with 5-attempt backoff over ~3,700 endpoints, derives generation from the /generation endpoint's species lists instead of guessing id ranges, and compacts the output onto the wire — and the defensiveEffectiveness function it feeds (app.js:51-64) is one of the few in the field that combines both defending types correctly, including 0x immunities cancelling 2x weaknesses, verified line-for-line against live PokéAPI relations.

## Vendored source

The source in this directory is the code the model wrote, copied verbatim from [its repo](https://github.com/guitaripod/pokedex-fable-5-low) minus `node_modules`, build output, and generated data.

> Generated PokéAPI JSON (public/data, ~2 MB) stripped from the vendored source; regenerate with `node scripts/build-data.mjs && node scripts/build-moves.mjs`.

Canonical history and issues live in the [original repo](https://github.com/guitaripod/pokedex-fable-5-low). This is a scored snapshot for the benchmark.
